gallery.selection: lexicographically first complete matching-source gallery path

rules.E: Most negative conservative global delta lower = candidate global lower - matched global upper
rules.I: Largest positive conservative delta upper = candidate upper - matched lower
rules.S: Largest positive nominal delta; most negative nominal delta; nearest to the median over every numeric pair. Delta intervals accompany all selections.
rules.missing: NA is retained, never replaced by0/1; all16 registered paired rows remain delivered
rules.multiple_categories: One case may legitimately occur in multiple categories. No replacement to increase apparent diversity.
rules.selection_is_not: Not a success decision, checkpoint choice, generalization claim, or human usability study
rules.ties: retain all ties; lexicographic request_id is display first
rules.visual: Explicit actual AI_VISUAL_REVIEW WORSE for these exact model labels and request; conservative S increase, or S lower delta>=-.005 and conservative I reduction or E increase

record.condition_observation: Known blue seat/support stays visible; free geometry does not form a consistently clean continuation.
record.feedback_observation: TR has a large purple duplicate region on the side of the seat and red E occlusion there. Capped reduces that concentrated I/E patch, while S remains mostly red and the severe free fragments remain visible.
record.geometry_observation: Seat is fragmented with floating or projecting back-side triangular spikes and a leaning slivered back; teacher seat/back is substantially more coherent. Chair remains recognizable, so no confident whole-body collapse flag.
record.geometry_vs_TR: Capped front back is more filled than TR, but new seat and rear fragments remain; neither result is clean.
record.geometry_vs_teacher: Seat is fragmented with floating or projecting back-side triangular spikes and a leaning slivered back; teacher seat/back is substantially more coherent. Chair remains recognizable, so no confident whole-body collapse flag.

record.condition_observation: The blue back and projecting known seat triangle remain; orange geometry is stepped away from the blue region with imperfect alignment.
record.feedback_observation: S is mostly red except for parts of the inner upright; I retains a red/purple junction band; E is mostly green/unknown. The back cuts are free-surface defects not summarized by the C markers.
record.geometry_vs_START: Compared with START's mostly pinholed back, cap has larger elongated back openings and a more interrupted lower-back transition.
record.geometry_vs_TR: Cap introduces multiple visible free-back slits where TR's back is largely continuous. Both retain an irregular folded front seat lip.
record.geometry_vs_teacher: Cap has more and longer white cuts in the free back panel than teacher, plus openings at the lower-back/seat transition; overall seat and legs remain recognizable.
